description: This file defines types, functions, and constants related to path context handling and route path normalization for a server plugin system. It includes utilities for normalizing path prefixes, matching paths against protected route prefixes, and resolving plugin route contexts with security considerations.

classes.name: PluginRoutePathContext
classes.description: Type defining the structure of a plugin route path context, including pathname, canonical path, candidates, and encoding flags.
